item.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Look Ahead to Next Round of Talks
item.description: Iran’s foreign minister said that new negotiations with the United States would start immediately after their preliminary deal is signed on Friday. President Trump said he hoped the conflict would soon be in the “rearview mirror.”

item.title: Live Updates: At G7 Summit, Trump Says Ukraine War Has ‘No Impact’ on U.S.
item.description: After the United States reached a preliminary deal with Iran, the mood seemed lighter than had been expected. But President Trump’s remarks highlighted persistent divisions among the allies.

item.title: Middle East live: Oil dips to lowest price since March on talk of Hormuz Strait reopening
item.description: Oil prices sank again on Tuesday, hitting $US80 per barrel for the first time since early March on the back of an announcement by US President Donald Trump of the Strait of Hormuz's reopening on Friday. It comes as the US and Iran are expected to formally sign a ceasefire settlement later this week and open negotiations about Tehran’s nuclear programme. Follow our liveblog for all the latest developments.

item.title: Is it a renter's market? It depends on where you live
item.description: About 40% of rentals on Zillow offer move-in deals, like a month of free rent, thanks to a construction boom that created an apartment surplus in some parts of the United States.

item.title: How Israel could complicate Iran peace negotiations. And, World Cup highlights
item.description: Israel has been sidelined in the agreement between the U.S. and Iran. It could spoil peace negotiations. And, it's been a thrilling start to the World Cup.

item.title: Iran war 'has been a strategic disaster for the State of Israel', analyst says
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is on a collision course with Donald Trump as the US president seeks to extricate himself from the Iran war, with both men's goals unmet and Israeli military operations tied down in Lebanon. item.title: Israeli ambassador to U.S. says Israel is 'not going to withdraw from South Lebanon'
item.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks Israel's ambassador to the U.S. Michael Leiter about the peace deal the Trump administration says it's made with Iran.

item.title: Iran deal: Trump is back to square one, but the cards are now in Tehran’s favor
item.description: The signing of the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the US and Iran on Monday has been welcomed by the international community after a devastating three-month war. The agreement was announced on June 14, President Donald Trump’s birthday, but the biggest beneficiary, experts say, is the Iranian regime.

item.title: What we know about the US-Iran memorandum of understanding
item.description: The United States and Iran, ⁠as well as mediator Pakistan, ​have provided few details about the preliminary deal announced Sunday to bring an end to the US-Iran conflict that has engulfed the region and threatened global energy supplies.

item.title: Interim US-Iran peace deal sparks anger among Israelis, who lash out at Netanyahu
item.description: Israelis from across the political spectrum reacted angrily Monday to the news of an initial deal between the U.S. and Iran, calling it a disaster for Israel and directing their fury at one man: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky reports from Jerusalem.
